blocks.html: Hyperlocal shopping app MallDash.ph easily helps busy people save hours in time and money on gas or commute. This Chinese New Year, MallDash and Robinsons Malls will bring customers even more savings with CNY 2022 promo!

To save and manage time, MallDash offers on-demand pick-up or delivery in 1 hour. Prudent shoppers can schedule pick-up or delivery for a future time or date up to the next 3 days in advance. Once the order is received, the customer can choose to pay in cash or GCash.

And for shoppers who want the convenience of Pabili, they just simply have to upload an image of their shopping list on MallDash Pabili section. It’s a time-saving feature loyal MallDash shoppers enjoy!

Shopping for group meals, tikoy, noodles, home decors, red envelopes, and more can be done in 1 transaction without the need to worry on top-up fees. MallDash.ph allows multiple orders from various restaurants, stores, even in grocery and department store inside Robinsons Malls. No top-up fees!

Customers can choose pick-up or delivery depending on which meets the need. People within 8 km from Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Place Las Pinas, Robinsons Magnolia, and 6 km from Robinsons Place Las Pinas can stay safe at home and wait for their CNY feast to arrive - free of delivery charge during the entire promo period.
For every order, a MallDash Dasher is assigned to verify, shop and fulfill orders until all items reach the customer’s door. It’s like having a virtual assistant all throughout the shopping journey!

MallDash’s CNY 2022 promo will run from January 28 to February 1, 2022. Lucky MallDash shoppers will save time and money by using the promo codes below. Avail of savings of P268 for P800 minimum spent or P188 savings for P200 minimum spent.
Read the complete promo mechanics here: https://bit.ly/3fR8nLP
